status: experimental separate genuine R0 DIRECT graphics state-command execution

admitted_shape.queue_and_allocator: Genuine DIRECT Type and QueueFlag3D, same selected graphics-capable device/family. Default one queue per adapter; explicit attachment to the owned-fence scheduler permits bounded COPY/COMPUTE/DIRECT logical queues over one physical submission.
admitted_shape.bindings: Actual same-device KindGraphics pipeline and separately selected exact identical empty root; no implicit root binding.
admitted_shape.topology: TRIANGLELIST only, consumed by the existing baked triangle-list PSO. No dynamic-topology feature is invented.
admitted_shape.viewport: One immutable finite nonnegative D3D viewport, strictly positive size, precise f64 endpoints <=4096, ordered depth within[0,1]. This is the conservative guaranteed Vulkan floor, not a queried physical maximum.
admitted_shape.scissor: One immutable nonnegative nonempty rectangle with endpoints <=4096.
admitted_shape.close: Requires valid graphics pipeline/root identity and every explicit topology/viewport/scissor state.
admitted_shape.execution: Actual retained native allocator command buffer records GRAPHICS pipeline bind and Vulkan viewport/scissor, then real submission/timeline observation. Vulkan viewport receives y+height and negative height; depth passes unchanged.

ownership: Distinct non-Copy Compute/Graphics pipeline leases preserve stage kind. Root binding is independent. Candidate/previous owners release outside common lock, and final native-fault admission is atomic with each state swap and Close. Reset detaches old pending owners; matching runtime cookie and independent recording generation protect replacement storage from stale completion.
completion: One own accepted target, or explicit actual safe drain, controls release. Every attempted negative/uncertain submission retains pipeline/root/actual pool. Failed drain retains owners; cleanup permission never asserts successful work. No-attempt command prerequisite failure permits same closed-list retry.
unsupported: No render pass/dynamic rendering scope, render-target binding, image/RTV, clear, DrawInstanced, rasterized output/readback, or presentation.
No general graphics state dimensions, vertex buffers, descriptors, resources, extra shaders or full stage semantics.
No public native versions/CreateDevice/mandatory table advertisement or completed WDDM KMD/segment/page/cache/residency/budget/GPUVA contracts.
primary_references: Pinned WDK10.0.28000.0 original R0 d3d12umddi.h callbacks and descriptors.
